_about: Enemy factions. Archetype-based: each has a signature behaviour and a tactical answer, not an element. A squad on the battlefield is ONE foe type times a strength; mixed fights come from squads chained together on the map. spawn lists the squads the rift sends through together (the faction's formation as it appears on the map); boss names the massive foe a boss unit unpacks into. Shown to the player: name, flavour. design is internal and never shown: fantasy, signature (what the faction does), answer (how the player beats it).

entries.name: The Risen

design.fantasy: With the fall of civilization, the forces beyond the ether have no shortage of raw materials with which to create unstoppable abominations.
design.signature: Plentiful, damage mitigation, lower health but regenerates. Hard to put down and keep down.
design.answer: Big hits, damage-over-time to negate regen, armor piercing.

entries.flavour: Gate order four: nothing that has died passes the wall. Nothing.

entries.name: The Infernal Horde

design.fantasy: Everything they do is loud, on fire, and telegraphed from a mile away. That does not make it survivable.
design.signature: Hard hits on a telegraph. Fire and energy.

entries.flavour: Recruitment poster: THEY BROUGHT FIRE. WE BROUGHT BIGGER FIRE.

entries.name: The Chorus

design.fantasy: They do not fight the rules. They edit them.
design.signature: Bends the rules: corrupts faces, scrambles rerolls, swaps ranks.

entries.flavour: Field manual, appendix K: a face on the die that was never installed means the machine is compromised. Fight on.
